lines.text: Cain, a tiller of the soil, brought fruit as an offering, but the LORD favored Abel's offering and not Cain's.
If Cain refused to do right, sin was crouching at his door, but he killed Abel in the desert.
The LORD said Abel's blood cried out from the ground, and Cain would be a fugitive and a wanderer.
The LORD placed a mark on Cain, who settled in Nod and built a city named after his son Enoch.
Adam's wife gave birth to Seth, and Seth's son Enosh was born when men began calling on Baal.
